Admin routes of the payment methods module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/payment-methods

List payment methods

Parameters:

- `isActive` in query (boolean, optional).
- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, max 100, optional).
- `provider` in query (`"cod"`, `"manual"`, `"stripe"`, `"paypal"`, `"gift_card"`, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: Methods retrieved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## POST /v1/admin/payment-methods

Create payment method

Request body: [CreatePaymentMethodDto](#createpaymentmethoddto).

Responses:

- `201`: Created.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `409`: Code already in use.

## DELETE /v1/admin/payment-methods/{id}

Soft-delete payment method

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `204`: Deleted.
- `404`: Not found.

## GET /v1/admin/payment-methods/{id}

Get payment method

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Method retrieved.
- `404`: Not found.

## PATCH /v1/admin/payment-methods/{id}

Update payment method

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Request body: [UpdatePaymentMethodDto](#updatepaymentmethoddto).

Responses:

- `200`: Updated.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `404`: Not found.

## POST /v1/admin/payment-methods/reorder

Reorder payment methods

Request body: [ReorderPaymentMethodsDto](#reorderpaymentmethodsdto).

Responses:

- `204`: Reordered.
- `400`: Invalid ids payload.
- `404`: One or more ids unknown.

## Schemas

### CreatePaymentMethodDto

- `code` (string, pattern `/^[a-z0-9_]+$/`, min length 2, max length 50, required).
- `name` ([PaymentTranslatableDto](#paymenttranslatabledto), required).
- `description` ([OptionalTranslatableDto](#optionaltranslatabledto), optional).
- `provider` (`"cod"`, `"manual"`, `"stripe"`, `"paypal"`, `"gift_card"`, required).
- `isActive` (boolean, optional).
- `isTestMode` (boolean, optional).
- `sortOrder` (number, min 0, optional).
- `config` (object, optional).

### OptionalTranslatableDto

- `fr` (string, optional).
- `en` (string, optional).
- `ar` (string, optional).
- `default` (string, optional).

### PaymentTranslatableDto

- `fr` (string, optional).
- `en` (string, optional).
- `ar` (string, optional).
- `default` (string, required).

### ReorderPaymentMethodsDto

- `ids` (array of string, required).

### UpdatePaymentMethodDto

- `name` ([OptionalTranslatableDto](#optionaltranslatabledto), optional).
- `description` ([OptionalTranslatableDto](#optionaltranslatabledto), optional).
- `isActive` (boolean, optional).
- `isTestMode` (boolean, optional).
- `sortOrder` (number, min 0, optional).
- `config` (object, optional).
